failureModes.prompt: If this change turns out wrong, can we put the information back exactly as it was?
failureModes.why: it decides whether a mistake costs an hour or is permanent

options.label: Keep the old shape until proven
Change in place
options.consequence: faster, and a mistake cannot be undone

failureModes.recommended: Keep the old shape until proven
failureModes.provenBy: a test that runs the change and the reversal, then asserts the information matches the original

failureModes.prompt: While the change runs, is it acceptable that some people see updated information and others see the old?
failureModes.why: a long change is never instant, so somebody is always mid-way

options.label: Both versions must read correctly
options.consequence: more work, nobody sees a broken screen

options.label: Brief inconsistency is fine
options.consequence: simpler, some people see odd data for a while

failureModes.provenBy: a test that reads through both the old and the new shape while the change is half applied

failureModes.prompt: Can any information be shortened, dropped, or merged away by this change?
failureModes.why: a narrowed or combined field silently destroys what does not fit

options.label: Nothing may be lost
options.consequence: needs a check before and after, and a copy kept

options.label: Known losses are acceptable
options.consequence: faster, and the lost part never comes back

failureModes.provenBy: a count and checksum of the affected records taken before and after the change

failureModes.prompt: Does every affected record clearly belong to somebody after this change?
failureModes.why: whose data this is decides every later query, screen, and permission

options.label: Ownership is explicit on every record
options.consequence: more columns now, no retrofit later

options.label: Infer it from related tables
options.consequence: simpler now, expensive and risky to correct

failureModes.recommended: Ownership is explicit on every record
failureModes.provenBy: a query asserting no affected record has an empty or unresolved owner

failureModes.prompt: If the change stops halfway, should it resume or start again from the beginning?
failureModes.why: a long backfill will be interrupted at least once

options.label: Resume from where it stopped
options.consequence: needs progress tracking, safe to retry

options.label: Start again
options.consequence: simpler, and repeats work that may double-apply

failureModes.provenBy: a test that kills the process mid-run and asserts a rerun completes without duplicating work

failureModes.prompt: Will app versions people have not updated still work after this change?
failureModes.why: phones update on their own schedule, and old versions keep sending the old shape

options.label: Old versions keep working
options.consequence: the old shape is accepted for a period

options.label: Require the new version
options.consequence: simpler, and people on old builds are stuck

failureModes.provenBy: a request in the previous shape answered correctly after the change is applied
